verdict.rationale: Jitsu Functions can be built and deployed from your own repo with jitsu-cli (init scaffolds a TypeScript project with tests, deploy ships it), and the CLI manages workspace configuration objects, so versioning and review can be done through git. An audit log adds some visibility into changes. Rollback, though, is only implied by redeploying an earlier commit; there is no evidence of native version history or one-click rollback. missing for 10: built-in version history for functions/pipeline config, a documented review/approval workflow, an explicit rollback mechanism, independent or hands-on corroboration.
